info.title: SpeakMate shared FE-BE contract
info.description: Two-person, three-day demo. All 24 P0 backend operations implemented and checked against disposable MySQL (external AI stubbed). Five P1 endpoints remain CONTRACT_ONLY. Live Gemini/Google/SMTP and Android learning integration are not yet verified. MySQL v3. UTC timestamps, numeric IDs, 1-based pagination; snake_case only token response fields.

post.summary: Sign in with a SpeakMate password
Sign in/create account with a verified Google ID token
Revoke current access and refresh session
Explicitly link Google to this account
Consume reset code and revoke sessions

get.description: Name ascending, id ascending. Suggested topic level does not restrict the learner's chosen level.

post.summary: Create a conversation; learner speaks first

200.description: Same createRequestId and same topicId/level returns existing conversation

post.summary: Accept one USER turn and generate only an AI reply

202.description: The same turn is still running; retryAfterSeconds describes remaining90s lease

Retry-After.description: GET status after3seconds; does not authorize a second AI attempt.

post.description: AI call is synchronous outside DB transactions; AI timeout20s. On502/503, GET conversation and retry the same requestId/content. New requestId while a previous turn is unresolved is409.

post.summary: Close once, then review a frozen transcript

Retry-After.description: GET status after3seconds; does not authorize a second AI attempt.

post.description: No request body. Commit endedAt before AI. Timeout45s; failure keeps closed conversation and sets FAILED. Repeated finish never changes endedAt.

get.summary: Read review state/result without starting AI work

post.summary: Retry FAILED or expired PROCESSING review

202.description: An active attempt is still running

Retry-After.description: GET status after3seconds; does not authorize a second AI attempt.

post.description: No body. Requires a closed conversation. COMPLETED/INSUFFICIENT_DATA returns existing result; never forces repeated paid AI calls.

get.summary: List own personal words; no decks

post.description: All IDs must be valid/owned/from COMPLETED reports or the entire request fails. Duplicate spelling returns existing word without overwriting meaning. Stable processing order: suggestionId ascending.

patch.description: NEW is initial-only in this operation. Backend sets lastReviewedAt; flipping a card alone sends no request.

put.summary: Replace topic content for future conversations
put.description: Omitted description becomes null. Does not alter active or existing snapshots.

patch.summary: P1: edit own display name/default level
patch.description: Reject explicit null, empty body, or fields other than name/level. Does not rewrite historical snapshots.

patch.summary: P1: enable/disable a USER; ADMIN accounts protected
patch.description: Never accepts role changes. ADMIN targets including current admin cannot be disabled. Disabling USER increments authVersion and clears refresh token/expiry.

get.summary: P1: count real data, including COMPLETED reports only

Error.description: HTTP status is authoritative. Read error code; never parse message text as business logic. Generic model lists possible errors, not a promise that every code applies to every operation.

password.description: Nonblank; <=72 UTF-8 bytes; do not trim.
DTO accepts <=256 chars; actual BCrypt verification accepts <=64 chars and <=72 UTF-8 bytes, otherwise generic401.

idToken.description: Google ID token for configured WEB client ID, never a Google access token/client secret.

pollAfterSeconds.description: GET polling interval, not an AI processing lease. Processing=3; terminal=0.
